description: Load on the REAL olife-sandboxd: 500 scripted entities (typical: move on a circle, rotate, read view of <= 8 within 6 blocks, keep state) of 50 owners x 10 + 2 bots. Reports world ms/tick (TickResult rows after warm-up), sandbox service ms/tick, fuel/credits per owner. NOT a clean perf claim (no idle gate): the clean run is `lab perf olife sandbox_load`.
